evidence_inputs.rows: intramolecular chimeras (both arms on gene_id) whose arms lie inside the folded region

meta.coordinates: 1-based inclusive positions on the gene_id reference sequence (windows, pairs.tsv i/j, ct column 6)

evidence.transform: IRIS-style Gaussian arm blocks; symmetric outer product; threshold 1e-6; log1p
evidence.evidenceWeight: one per eligible HYB row; overlap_score and collapsed raw-read count are not weights
